preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin consists of a single integer.

preconditions.expression: int(stdin.splitlines()[0].strip()) == T and T >= 1 and T <= 30
preconditions.description: The first line is T (1 ≤ T ≤ 30), the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.strip()) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line is N (2 ≤ N ≤ 1000), the size of the permutation to construct.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == ' '.join(str(x) for x in permutation) for permutation in permutations
postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout contains exactly one permutation of {1, 2, ..., N} as space-separated integers, where N is the input for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == N for N, permutation in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation has exactly N elements, matching the input N for that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(set(permutation) == set(range(1, N + 1)) for N, permutation in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], permutations))
postconditions.description: Each permutation is a valid permutation of {1, 2, ..., N}, containing each integer exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(median(prefix_i) != median(prefix_j) for i in range(len(permutation) - 1) for prefix_i, prefix_j in zip(prefixes, prefixes[1:]))
postconditions.description: For every prefix P_i of length i (1 ≤ i < N), the median of P_i is not equal to the median of P_{i+1}, where prefixes are all possible contiguous prefixes of the permutation.
